text: […These are the words of Ezekiel. The word of the LORD came to me, saying: ‘Son …’]
[…of man, prophesy and say: ‘Behold, a day of destruction for the nations is coming …’]
[…Egypt … panic fell upon Put, and a sword came upon Egypt …]
[…will collapse; and Cush … [or: Pul?] … the leaders of Arabia, and some of the sons of …] [The reading is uncertain.]
[…the covenant? … and Arabia will fall at the gates of Egypt; they will perish (or: you will perish) …]
[…by the sword of Egypt you will be ravaged …]
[…Egypt …] [Only a fragment of the place name survives.]
